feature: STARTS_WITH / ENDS_WITH / CONTAINS substring predicates in WHERE

scenarios.name: STARTS_WITH matches a name prefix
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.name STARTS_WITH "Neighbor" RETURN n.entity_id AS id ORDER BY id

scenarios.name: ENDS_WITH matches a name suffix
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.name ENDS_WITH "a" RETURN n.entity_id AS id ORDER BY id

scenarios.name: CONTAINS matches an interior substring
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.name CONTAINS "Island" RETURN n.entity_id AS id ORDER BY id

scenarios.name: string match is case-sensitive
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.name STARTS_WITH "neighbor" RETURN n.entity_id AS id ORDER BY id

scenarios.name: an empty needle matches every string
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.name STARTS_WITH "" RETURN n.entity_id AS id ORDER BY id

scenarios.name: needle supplied by a param
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.name ENDS_WITH $suffix RETURN n.entity_id AS id ORDER BY id

scenarios.name: a null needle matches nothing (two-valued: predicate is false, no ORM crash)
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/string (Cypher: a null needle makes STARTS WITH null/unknown; TAP is two-valued — a null operand short-circuits the predicate to false so every row drops, and never leaks a raw `Cannot use None as a query value`)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.name STARTS_WITH null RETURN n.entity_id AS id ORDER BY id

scenarios.name: NOT over a null-needle predicate matches every row (two-valued NOT(false)=true; diverges from Cypher)
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/string (Cypher's NOT(null) is null so no rows survive; TAP's two-valued null operand makes the inner predicate false, so NOT flips it to true and EVERY row matches. Same two-valued shape as the committed NOT-over-IN-with-null scenario)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE NOT (n.name STARTS_WITH null) RETURN n.entity_id AS id ORDER BY id

scenarios.name: NOT negates a string predicate to the complement set
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/string (NOT of a STARTS WITH returns the complement of the matched rows)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE NOT n.name STARTS_WITH "Neighbor" RETURN n.entity_id AS id ORDER BY id

scenarios.name: a whitespace needle is matched literally
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/string (a needle containing a space matches only where that exact space occurs)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.name CONTAINS "Island " RETURN n.entity_id AS id ORDER BY id

scenarios.name: a control-character needle is matched literally
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/string (a tab needle is matched byte-for-byte, not normalized, so it matches nothing here)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.name CONTAINS "	" RETURN n.entity_id AS id ORDER BY id

scenarios.name: STARTS_WITH coerces a numeric operand to its text form and prefix-matches (current behavior; diverges from Cypher)
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/string (Cypher yields null when STARTS WITH is applied to a non-string operand; TAP instead casts the typed column to text — severity_score::text LIKE '1%' — so 10 and 15 match. Documented divergence, not Cypher parity)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.data.severity_score STARTS_WITH "1" RETURN n.entity_id AS id ORDER BY id

scenarios.name: a needle equal to the whole value matches just that node
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/string (a needle equal to the entire value still satisfies the prefix predicate)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.name STARTS_WITH "Island Alpha" RETURN n.entity_id AS id ORDER BY id

scenarios.name: prefix AND suffix predicates narrow the result
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/string (conjunction of a prefix and a suffix predicate narrows to their intersection)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.name STARTS_WITH "Neighbor" AND n.name ENDS_WITH "e" RETURN n.entity_id AS id ORDER BY id

scenarios.name: prefix AND substring AND suffix predicates narrow to one node
scenarios.inspired_by: opencypher TCK — expressions/string (three conjoined string predicates intersect to a single node)
scenarios.query: MATCH (n:pg_node) WHERE n.name STARTS_WITH "Island" AND n.name CONTAINS "Alph" AND n.name ENDS_WITH "a" RETURN n.entity_id AS id ORDER BY id
